confirmed_botany: Texas bluegrass is a rhizomatous perennial with separate pistillate and staminate plants. Photographer-labeled actual pistillate sources POAR-FS/F2/F3 show real exceptionally long fine basal hair webs on female floret/spikelets; male florets can still have sparse hair. Both P. annua and P. arachnifera have true membranous ligules and prow-shaped leaf tips, not species-exclusive.
